subject: general
question: Who was appointed as the State Election Commissioner of Jammu and Kashmir on October 30, 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kewal Kumar Sharma.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kewal Kumar Sharma **was appointed as the State Election Commissioner of Jammu and Kashmir on October 30, 2020.
 
• She who was serving as Adviser to Jammu and Kashmir Lt. Governor Manoj Sinha was appointed State Election Commissioner (SEC).
 
• Mr Sharma, a 1983 batch IAS officer, was appointed as Adviser to the L-G in November 2019.
 
• He has also served as Chief Secretary of Delhi and Goa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha has announced a committee to work out modalities for the economic revival of the union territory and extending support to its business community.
 
• The announcement was made during an interaction with the representatives of the Kashmir Chamber of Commerce and Industry (KCCI) at the Raj Bhavan auditorium on 17 August.
 
• The interaction was organised to get a first-hand appraisal of the issues and problems of the business community.
 
• The committee will be headed by the advisor to the Lt Governor, Kewal Kumar Sharma.
